g.text: Figure A2: a run that repeats itself sends many calls and few different

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: round two, 138 of 144 runs; the rest are the runs the seconds limit ended, reaped before their

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: record was written. On the diagonal, every reply in the run was different.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Every point below the diagonal is a run that sent a reply it had already sent, against verification

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: output that had not changed. No point can sit above it: both counters are written by the executor over

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the same calls, so a run cannot record more different replies than calls. A shaded disc with a number is

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: that many runs at the same point, its area scaled to the count.
